That is Oren Castle... Hiccup~! Past the castle, cross the river and keep heading north... you will reach the Ivory Tower, home…

I truly was at the pinnacle of success! Many heroes of that day would trust only me for thier weapons and armor. I made the sword of Sir Ce…

I was highly respected by all, but still I wanted more. I dreamed of creating a masterpiece that would go down in history. It was all I could thi…

default/31002-5.htm.text: Maestro Reorin: It was the evil Death Lord Hallate. He who leads the army of darkness... He who is known as the insolent invader or the archenemy of the angels. He made me an offer that I couldn't refuse. He promised me that he would help me to create a masterpiece that would go down in history. Ig…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-01.htm.text: Maestro Reorin: Hiccup~! Hey you whippersnapper! Stop bothering me...Go on, bother someone else!

links.text: "I am here to ask you to make a weapon for me."

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-01a.htm.text: Maestro Reorin: Garrr! Go away, boy, and stop bothering me! (Only characters level 75 and above are permitted to take on this quest.)

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-09.html.text: Maestro Reorin: Please help me send my darling Reiria to her eternal rest. She is being held captive by Messenger Cabrio . He can be found hovering around the Cemetery of Aden. He is a fearsome foe. I am trusting you to free the soul of my wife from his evil clutches! But mark my words, if she is m…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-10.html.text: Maestro Reorin: The soul of Reiria is at rest... Yes, I feel she is finally at peace! My friend, I am in your debt. Now I shall have my revenge on her tormentor. My honor can now be restored, but I will need your help!

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-12.html.text: Maestro Reorin: My friend, I must have your help recovering the three infernium scepters from Death Lord Hallate and his minions . They are the most powerful weapons I have ever created, and if you help me get them back, I will melt them in a furnace and make a new weapon for you!

links.text: "Tell me more about Death Lord Hallate."

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-13.html.text: Maestro Reorin: Is it true? Have you really slain Death Lord Hallate and his underlings...? Indeed, the mysterious woman was telling the truth. Yes, the infernium scepters... My greatest masterpiece and the key to my downfall... Now, I will gladly destroy them and create an even more powerful weapo…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-15.html.text: Maestro Reorin: Go and see my former apprentice, Cliff. He will have the Infernium Varnish . He is a warehouse keeper in the Town of Oren . I am so embarassed by the way I treated him that I cannot bear to go myself...

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-16.html.text: Maestro Reorin: Ah, the Infernium Varnish! I wish that you hadn't told him so much... I just wanted you to get the Varnish, not gossip about my personal business! Anyway, thanks for the Varnish. Things are going well. Yesterday, I received a letter from the president of the Black Anvil Guild! He sa…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-18.html.text: Maestro Reorin: To make A-Grade A weapon for you, I must have my special hammer! It is currently in the possession of Head Blacksmith Ferris of the Town of Aden . At one time he was my apprentice but when I had my problems with the guild he turned against me. I cannot bear to see him. Please go and…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-19.html.text: Maestro Reorin: Ah, my hammer! Good job! It feels good to hold it in my hand again. How long has it been! The infernium is almost ready to be formed... Now the work can begin! Ah, yes, all I need now is the mold... Ahem...

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-21.html.text: Maestro Reorin: I sold the mold to buy liqueur! There, I said it! Now, please, go and see Trader Zenkin of the Town of Oren and see if he will sell it back to me. Please!

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-22.html.text: Maestro Reorin: My goodness, you had to go all the way to the Tower of Insolence to get this for me? Good job! Thanks to you, I can finally begin work on the weapon! Now I only need the last ingredient...

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-24.html.text: Maestro Reorin: If I apply this formula to the mass of the metal and allow for its tensile strength... I have determined that I will need exactly 984 B-Grade crystals . Please bring them to me immediately!

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-25.html.text: Maestro Reorin: Did you bring all 984 Grade B Crystals? You came just in time. We've reached the perfect temperature for inserting the Crystals... Uh huh, it's not over yet! I still need one more ingredient. Pure Infernium is too soft to be made into weapons.It must be mixed with high quality Mithr…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/31002-35a.html.text: Maestro Reorin: I understand it's a difficult task, but please bring me the Sword of Damascus . Remember, augmented weapons or standard weapons cannot be used. Don't forget!

My desire to create a masterpiece has been my ruin! However, I cannot turn back the hands of time. My honor has been destroyed and all of my apprentices have abandoned me. My pr…

I... cannot refuse their requests. They have the soul of my wife, and are holding her hostage! If I don't do exactly as they say, they will throw her soul into e…

links.text: "I will rescue the soul of your wife!"

Cabrio, the messenger of Shilen is the one who holds the soul of my wife in his grasp... However, if what that beautiful woman said is true... if you really are "the one who will shape the face of this continent …

links.text: "I will save the soul of your wife!"
